body: Concrete core/native coupling prerequisite: RepositoryWorkspace.execute (workspace.ts 668-669) safeFlushes EVERY mutation and openStore also flushes; default repo mode tracks metadata (.gitignore only local/). From an otherwise clean registered-root target checkout, prepareLearningApproval therefore creates its own untracked .darkmechanicus/learnings/learning_integration/<operationId>.json BEFORE native preparation; persist/receipt callbacks update that same file. Accepted native preparation currently requires status.files.length===0, so naive protocol wiring self-conflicts in repo mode and cannot recover after restart. Cover this with an actual repo-mode Workspace command + real Git consumer, not only injected mocks. Recommended bounded adapter/native extension: explicitly preserve ONLY the trusted current operation’s owned untracked portable record, derived from actual core layout/id (never renderer or persisted engine-plan paths), and only while the prepared Git tree does not change that path. Preserve exact bytes/index and keep all other dirty/staged/conflicting/foreign files rejected; no blanket .darkmechanicus ignore, fake Git status, auto-commit/stash/reset, mode switch or export suppression. DB-mode remains strict/no record. Revalidate the allowance from current trusted registration on recovery. This is necessary protocol glue within the existing feature, not permission to weaken canonical safety or add a synchronization framework. Complete native CAS prerequisite first; do not expand the active DM-801 scope mid-clock.
